mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_LOGS (ADMIN_USER_ID, ACTION, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_ID, PAYLOAD) VALUES (#{adminUserId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{payload})
mapper.select: SELECT A.LOG_ID, A.ADMIN_USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS ADMIN_NICKNAME, A.ACTION, A.TARGET_TYPE, A.TARGET_ID, A.PAYLOAD, A.CREATED_AT FROM ADMIN_LOGS A JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = A.ADMIN_USER_ID ORDER BY A.CREATED_AT DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT USER_ID, EMAIL, NICKNAME, ROLE, STATUS, OAUTH_PROVIDER, LAST_LOGIN_AT, CREATED_AT FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DELETED_AT IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE USERS SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USERS SET ROLE = #{role}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE LISTINGS SET STATUS = #{status}, REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE LISTING_ID = #{listingId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LISTING_REPORTS R
AND R.STATUS = #{status}

SELECT R.REPORT_ID, R.LISTING_ID, L.TITLE AS LISTING_TITLE, R.REPORTER_USER_ID, U.NICKNAME AS REPORTER_NICKNAME, R.REASON, R.STATUS, R.CREATED_AT FROM LISTING_REPORTS R JOIN LISTINGS L ON L.LISTING_ID = R.LISTING_ID JOIN USERS U ON U.USER_ID = R.REPORTER_USER_ID WHERE R.REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LISTING_REPORTS SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE REPORT_ID = #{reportId}
